why: UA1C11/105/35 Phi Mu Composite, 2012. A composite of individual oval studio portraits with a full positional key printed on it: the record's own description lists every face row by row, 'top row l to r ... 2nd row l to r ...'. That is a numbered key good enough to identify a single face with certainty, which is otherwise impossible for these years because no Talisman was published 2004-2011. This one volume carries four people from the n0813 worklist.

UA1C11/105/34 Phi Mu Composite, 2011. Positional row-by-row key. Forsythe is named in the top row: 'top row l to r: katie basham, mary witsiepe, stacie bratcher, hannah stoltz, eileen forsythe, madison beach...' - fifth face in the top row, an exact position.

UA1C11/105/33 Phi Mu Composite, 2010. Positional key; Starkey is in the 3rd row, seventh name: '3rd row l to r: jennifer harry, meredith hassell, krista jakobi, karoline johnson, sarah myers, brenda sherlock, ladarra starkey...'. Nearest in date to her 2008-09 SGA year of the three composites that name her.

UA1C11/105/31 Phi Mu Composite, 2008 - the same academic year as her SGA service. Positional key: '7th row l to r: devin roos, brenda sherlock, kayla smith, katelyn spralding, ladarra starkey, kelli stuntebeck...'. Prefer this one over the 2010 composite if both are reachable.

positions.LaDarra Starkey: 7th row, 5th from left (Devin Roos, Brenda Sherlock, Kayla Smith, Katelyn Spralding, LaDarra Starkey, ...)

why: UA1C11/105/36 Phi Mu Composite, 2013 - the year of their SGA service. Positional key naming all three: Nitzken third in the top row, Duncan ninth in the top row, Manley in the 5th row.

UA1C11/105/37 Phi Mu Composite, 2014. Positional key: '3rd row l to r: abby blandford, brenna duncan, makenze evans, kylie foushee, cassidy haley, leah hotchkiss, alyson manley, natalie mullins. 4th row l to r: shelby nitzken, ...'. A fallback if the 2013 composite scan is poor.

College Heights Herald 85:39, 23 March 2010. The index line is 'candidates for student government association executive vice president - kendrick bryan, currie martin'. Herald election coverage in this period ran a headshot of each candidate beside their name, so this issue is the most likely portrait of Martin anywhere in the archive.

College Heights Herald 87:29, 20 March 2012: 'three candidates vie for student government association president - cory dodds, austin wingate, corey johnson'. A three-way presidential race, which the Herald illustrated with a headshot of each candidate.

2013 Talisman: Form. Carries a full feature headed 'a vote for support - austin wingate' by Allyson Beasecker. A magazine feature on a named subject is almost always photographed, and the Talisman prints large. No Talisman exists for 2004-2011, so 2013 is the first volume that can show these people at all.

2014 Talisman: Reckoning, Part I. Feature 'stories to tell - warren county regional jail, sandra zemter, brittany eldridge, mallory treece' by Jordan Kassel. A named subject in a photo-led Talisman feature.

College Heights Herald 84:22 [32], 17 February 2009. Two separate items: a full profile, 'puzzle expert looks to future outside kentucky - jacob turner' by Mike Stunson, which is the kind of single-subject feature the Herald always photographed; and 'student government association chief justice resigns - lisa kappler' by Mary Barczak.

College Heights Herald 84:33, 19 February 2009: 'student government association approves new chief justice - corey bewley' by Mary Barczak. Bewley is the successor Chief Justice named in the worklist and this is the story of his approval.

College Heights Herald 86:12, 12 October 2010: 'what did you do for fall break - rebecca schaefer, bobby johnson, drew mitchell, jessica najar, amber matthews, amy silva'. The Herald's vox-pop page ran a small mugshot of each person quoted, each captioned with the name, so this yields a clean identified face.

College Heights Herald 85:42, 2 April 2010: 'pedal to the metal: fraternity to ride 3,200 miles for alzheimer's research - phi gamma delta, tyler jury' by Laurel Wilson. A named subject in a sports/feature story.

College Heights Herald 86:1, 31 August 2010: '107 days around the world - tyler jury, david keeling, roger murphy, cynthia worcester, anna mantooth, dao nguyen' by Rialda Zukic. A travel feature, which the Herald illustrated heavily.

College Heights Herald 85:13, 23 October 2009: 'three student government association senators resign - michel stephens, daniel shaw, emmett stephens' by Shakia Harris. Note this frame is tied to a resignation, so it is a last resort under the archive's own rule, but it is the only located photograph opportunity for Shaw.

College Heights Herald 85:20, 17 November 2009: 'western students work for politicians - timothy morris, monique braun, timothy gilliam' by Spencer Jenkins. Three named students in a feature; needs a caption check to tell which figure is Gilliam.

College Heights Herald 89:17, 24 October 2013: 'alums start leatherwork business, plan to unveil wku products at homecoming - clayton & crume, clay simpson, tyler jury' by Kayla Boyd. A business feature on two named founders, so the caption should place each of them.

UA1C11/105/27 Phi Mu Composite, 2004 - the same academic year as their SGA service. Row-by-row positional key: '7th row l to r: Natalie Gore, Amanda Hutchins, Katie Jeter, Calli Lovell, ... Jessica sutton, Tabitha Williams, Cara Wright.' Jeter is third in the 7th row, Sutton fourteenth. No Talisman was published 1994-2012, so a keyed composite is the only route to a face for these two.

UA1C11/105/30 Phi Mu Composite, 2007 - the year of her SGA service. Positional key: '7th row l to r: Melissa Durham, Dawn Foster, Jennifer Harry, Andrea Hensgen, Amber Lee, Chelsea McCreary, Dianne McElroy, Danica Morrison, Valerie Pollard, Tessa Proctor, Ashley Solomon, LaDarra Starkey, Dajana Vasilijevic, Kristin Wilson, Amanda Yatso.' Thirteenth in the 7th row. The archive files her as Dajana Vasilijevic-Klingler; the composite gives the maiden name, and the name is rare enough to be safe.

UA12/2/1 Walk the Line, the Herald's May 2008 commencement edition. It carries a signed senior column, 'Redmon, Ben. Leaving the Party at 10:30 - Interfraternity Council'. The Herald runs a mugshot of the author beside each of these columns, which would be a captioned portrait of him in his own final semester.

UA12/2/35 The Greek Standard, Vol. 1, Issue 1, February 2007 (landing page stu_org/530). Opens with 'A Word from Ben Redmon, IFC President'. A council newsletter prints the president's photograph with his column. Second-best route to Redmon after the commencement edition.

College Heights Herald 78:47, 20 March 2003 - the spring 2003 election coverage, one candidate profile per person with a mugshot above it. The archived web version of one of these pieces proves the format: the photograph carries alt text and a caption bar with the candidate's name. Thirty people on the n0207 list first served in 2002-03 and sixteen in 2003-04, and no Talisman covers either year.
College Heights Herald 78:46, 18 March 2003. The other half of the spring 2003 election coverage (Martin, Peavie, Todd profiles are indexed in it), same mugshot-per-candidate format.

College Heights Herald 81:39, 4 April 2006, 'Student Government Association Candidates Agree on Many Issues'. The spring 2006 election produced the 2006-07 senate, which is the largest cohort on the n0207 list with no portrait at all - forty-six people. The 2004 and 2005 election sections both printed a mugshot grid of every senate candidate, and that grid is what is wanted here.

College Heights Herald 81:36, 14 March 2006, 'Three Candidates Run for President'. Start of the spring 2006 campaign coverage; a three-way race is normally illustrated with a headshot of each candidate, and the senate candidate profiles run alongside.

College Heights Herald 82:44 [43], 5 April 2007. Spring 2007 election week, which produced the 2007-08 senate - thirty-six people on the n0207 list with no portrait. The index lines for the April 2007 issues are truncated at 300 characters so the election items do not show locally, but the date is right and the Herald ran candidate profiles with mugshots in every other year of this period.
College Heights Herald 82:44, 10 April 2007 - the issue after the spring 2007 vote, which normally carries the result story with photographs of the winners. Same cohort as 6645.

UA77/1 WKU Spirit, 2007. The contents list a profile headed 'Scholarship Recipient Katherine Smith'. A donor magazine runs a photograph of the student with that kind of profile. Katherine Smith is a common name, so this one is only usable if the piece also gives a detail that ties her to the Katherine Smith who sat in the 2007-08 senate; worth a look rather than a certainty.

The 2015 Talisman is the last print yearbook that can carry a captioned student-government group photograph for the 2014-15 SGA. Thirty-two of the n1419 worklist have 2014-15 as their only year and the College Heights Herald photo library holds a captioned frame for almost none of them, so the yearbook is the only remaining route to a face for most of that cohort. Wanted: the student government spread and any numbered key beside it.

Same request for any Talisman volume covering 2015-16 through 2019-20, if the collection holds one. The SGA senate and judicial council group plates with printed name keys would settle identifications that no single Herald frame can.
